mapper.insert: insert into cart_item(user_id, product_id, sku_id, spec_text, quantity) values(#{userId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{specText}, #{quantity}) on duplicate key update quantity = quantity + values(quantity)
mapper.select: select c.id, p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, c.sku_id, s.sku_code, s.color, s.size, c.spec_text, p.image_url, coalesce(s.price, p.price) as price, c.quantity, coalesce(s.price, p.price) * c.quantity as subtotal from cart_item c join product p on p.id = c.product_id left join product_sku s on s.id = c.sku_id where c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.id
mapper.delete: delete from cart_item where user_id=#{userId} and product_id in #{id}
delete from cart_item where user_id=#{userId} and id in #{id}
